article.summary_es: CAMBA Food Pantry es una despensa de alimentos que aparece en el mapa Food Help NYC de la ciudad. Está en 21 Snyder Ave, Brooklyn, y reparte alimentos los martes y jueves.
article.summary_en: CAMBA Food Pantry is a food pantry listed on the City's Food Help NYC map. It is located at 21 Snyder Ave, Brooklyn, and distributes food on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
how_they_help_es: Es una despensa de alimentos según el mapa Food Help NYC de la ciudad.
Reparte alimentos los martes y jueves de 10am a 1pm.
Está ubicada en 21 Snyder Ave, Brooklyn, NY 11226.
Puede llamar al (718) 282-3082 para preguntar antes de ir.
how_they_help_en: It is a food pantry listed on the City's Food Help NYC map.
It distributes food on Tuesdays and Thursdays from 10am to 1pm.
It is located at 21 Snyder Ave, Brooklyn, NY 11226.
You can call (718) 282-3082 to ask questions before going.
visit_tips_es: El horario de la despensa es martes 10am-1pm y jueves 10am-1pm.
La lista no indica qué alimentos se entregan ni si hay requisitos; pregunte por teléfono al (718) 282-3082.
Verifique el horario antes de viajar, ya que puede cambiar.
visit_tips_en: Pantry hours are Tue 10am-1pm and Thu 10am-1pm.
The listing does not say what food is given or if there are any requirements; call (718) 282-3082 to ask.
Check the schedule before traveling, as it may change.
